field_policy.health: Source initial/current health only; not an attested personal maximum
field_policy.loyalty: Contextual initial loyalty; -- is a ruler display sentinel, retained as null
field_policy.lifespan_year: Original game setting only; does not replace canonical historical chronology
field_policy.faction_label: Literal source faction/retinue/location label; location-only labels map to no faction
field_policy.other_fields: Retained factual source columns only; not applied to martial/intellect/experience/equipment/chronology

identity_policy: Reviewed unique exact canonical names/aliases plus 12 explicit individual spelling/context decisions; no approximate-name or ability-based identity joins

identity_disagreements.note: Independent transcriptions assign different names to a matching numeric record. The new table identity was reviewed from spelling/context; no ROM/portrait identity is changed.
Independent transcriptions disagree on the displayed name. No ROM/portrait identity is changed, and numeric agreement does not establish identity.
